subject: food-technology

items.correct: Energy used to maintain basic bodily functions at complete rest.
items.why: Students think BMR is about exercise. It's the baseline energy needed just to STAY ALIVE - breathing, heart, brain, organ function - typically 60-70% of total daily energy use even before any activity.

items.q: UK EAR for women aged 19-64 is approximately:
items.why: It's 2,000 kcal/day. “1,200 kcal/day” is the classic near-miss here; knowing why it's wrong is worth as much as knowing the right answer.
It's 1.4. “1.9” is the classic near-miss here; knowing why it's wrong is worth as much as knowing the right answer.

items.q: If BMR is 1500 kcal/day and PAL is 1.6, TEE in kcal/day is:
items.why: Exact answer: 2400. Estimation gets you near it; only the anchored number survives the exam hall.
